prompts.prompt: Use the man in the reference photo (keep his face, grey hair, glasses and likeness recognizable), wearing his black leather jacket. Vertical 4:5 editorial news-magazine cover image, photorealistic cinematic style. Keep the bottom third fairly dark and simple (space for a headline). No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Do not show any woman. Scene: he stares in disbelief at a smartphone screen in a dark room, the phone's cold blue light on his face, many blurred glowing social-media notification bubbles floating around him, a large red rubber stamp mark (just a red rectangle outline, no letters) hovering in the air.
